projects.name: opsmate
projects.summary: A keyboard-driven Go TUI for day-to-day Kubernetes work: resources, logs, Helm releases, port-forwards, and pod shells.
projects.alt: opsmate on a local kind cluster: the dashboard flags failing pods, the log viewer shows why checkout-worker crashes, then the resource browser.

projects.name: bughunter
projects.summary: A Rust CLI for code analysis, Tree-sitter repository maps, structured reports, and configurable CI severity thresholds.
projects.alt: bughunter running a live AI-assisted scan of OWASP NodeGoat: the progress panel shows LLM requests, tokens and file reads climbing across shard 1 of 4.
